# GENERATED by `npm run core:api -- --update` — never hand-edit.
# The public API surface of the staged core (exports of out/core/index.d.ts,
# canonical printer output, sorted). Drift fails `npm run build`: an export
# added, renamed or re-typed is a contract change for staged consumers and
# must ride an extension version bump in the same unit. Re-run --update only
# as the acknowledgment step of that discipline (docs/dsh-bridge-plan.md).

  interface ModelConfig {
      id: string;

      defaultMode?: string;
      server: string;
      provider?: string;

      promptCache?: 'on' | '1h' | 'off';

      estimateCharsPerToken?: number;
      streamInactivityTimeout?: number;
      initialResponseTimeoutMs?: number;
      autoContinueRetries?: number;
      systemMessageReplacementsFile?: string;

          input?: number;
          output?: number;
          cachedInput?: number;
          currency?: string;
      };
  }

  interface ModelDescriptor {
      readonly configId: string;

      readonly outputLengthValues?: number[];

  }

## UsageLedger
  class UsageLedger {
      private readonly host;
      private readonly lastRequest;
      private allTime;
      private days;
      private startedAt;
      private allTimeCost;
      private daysCost;
      private lastWritten;
      private writeQueue;
      constructor(host: UsageLedgerHost);
      load(): Promise<void>;
      private adopt;
      recordRequest(data: LastRequestData): void;
      recordExternalRequest(data: LastRequestData): void;
      private accumulateRequest;
      getLastRequest(serverUrl: string): LastRequestData | undefined;
      getLatestRequest(): LastRequestData | undefined;
      getServerUsage(serverUrl: string): ServerUsage;
      getServerCost(serverUrl: string): ServerCost;
      hasServerUsage(serverUrl: string): boolean;
      getServersWithUsage(): string[];
      getModelStartedAt(serverUrl: string, modelId: string): number | undefined;
      reset(scope: 'all' | {
          serverUrl: string;
      }): void;
      flush(): Promise<void>;
      private snapshotMemory;
      private schedulePersist;
      private logError;
  }

## VllmChatOptions
  interface VllmChatOptions {
      max_tokens?: number;
      temperature?: number;
      top_p?: number;
      top_k?: number;
      min_p?: number;
      repetition_penalty?: number;
      presence_penalty?: number;
      frequency_penalty?: number;
      seed?: number;
      stop?: string | string[];
      min_tokens?: number;
      tools?: any[];
      tool_choice?: 'auto' | 'required' | 'none' | {
          type: 'function';
          function: {
              name: string;
          };
      };
      parallel_tool_calls?: boolean;
      continue_final_message?: boolean;
      add_generation_prompt?: boolean;
      bad_words?: string[];
      ignore_eos?: boolean;
      repetition_detection?: WireRepetitionDetectionConfig;
      structured_outputs?: WireStructuredOutputConfig;
  }
